# Embedded Emissions: Pig Iron (CN 7201), India

**Embedded emissions: 1,266.27 tCO2e**

## Inputs

| Input | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| CN code | 7201 (Pig iron and spiegeleisen) | In table |
| Country of production | India | Listed for CN 7201 |
| Quantity | 500.5 t | Provided |

## Factor

The table gives a default SEE of **2.53 tCO2e/t** for CN 7201 produced in India.

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × Quantity
= 2.53 tCO2e/t × 500.5 t
= 1,266.265 tCO2e
≈ **1,266.27 tCO2e** (2 decimal places)

The exact product, 1,266.265, ends in a half. I rounded it half-up to 1,266.27. If your system uses round-half-to-even (banker's rounding), it would report 1,266.26.
